slides.title: Optional Parameters 🔹
slides.content:
# Providing Defaults

You can make parameters optional by giving them a default value:

```csharp
void SpawnEnemy(string type = "Goblin", int count = 1)
{
    Debug.Log($"Spawning {count} {type}(s)");
}
```

Now you can call:
```csharp
SpawnEnemy();              // Uses defaults
SpawnEnemy("Orc", 3);      // Overrides both
SpawnEnemy(count: 5);      // Named argument, skips type
```

**Named arguments** let you specify which parameter you're assigning.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Avoid Too Many Parameters

If a method needs more than 3-4 parameters, consider grouping them into a custom class or struct (like WeaponStats). It keeps method signatures clean.
